column1: # Bounded leader-routed PD TSO source evidence.

column5: The retained cloneable PD worker routes one bounded TSO stream to the confirmed leader, refreshes membership on retryable failure, validates cluster identity and response shape, retires broken streams, and returns a strictly monotonic composed timestamp. Local TSO, service-mode switching, forwarding, TLS, batching, concurrent callers, metrics, and the full option surface remain open.

Each read requests exactly one timestamp and strictly validates header, cluster ID, count, timestamp presence, nonzero value, suffix bits, composition overflow, and monotonicity within the client lifetime. Batched request coalescing, cancellation queues, deadlines per enqueued request, and observability remain open.
